titleEn: What Scotland is getting wrong on recycling – and Wales is getting right
titleZh: 回收利用：苏格兰做错了什么，威尔士又做对了什么？
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: Scotland has ambitions to become an environmental leader, but its recycling rate has just fallen to a five-year low.
paragraphs.zh: 苏格兰有雄心成为环境领导者，但其回收率刚刚降至五年低点。

paragraphs.en: The Scottish household recycling rate fell from 44.3% in 2024 to 42.8% in 2025, according to recently released figures. These figures also show the levels vary widely across the country, with Glasgow one of the lowest local authorities at only 24% and Clackmannanshire at 56%. The Scottish government had previously set a recycling target of 70% of waste by 2025.
paragraphs.zh: 根据最近公布的数据，苏格兰家庭回收率从2024年的44.3%下降到2025年的42.8%。这些数据还显示，全国各地的水平差异很大，格拉斯哥是最低的地方当局之一，仅为24%，克拉克曼南郡为56%。苏格兰政府此前设定的目标是到2025年回收70%的废物。

paragraphs.en: It is tempting to blame Scottish households. But research has shown recycling is shaped by social, cultural and structural conditions. Participation improves when services fit people’s everyday lives and make recycling convenient. People need authorities to provide suitable local infrastructure, services and behavioural support to enable effective recycling.
paragraphs.zh: 人们很容易责怪苏格兰的家庭。但研究表明，回收利用受到社会、文化和结构条件的影响。当服务适合人们的日常生活并使回收利用变得方便时，参与度就会提高。人们需要当局提供合适的地方基础设施、服务和行为支持，以实现有效的回收利用。

paragraphs.en: Scotland’s recycling services remain inconsistent and confusing. This is partly down to the continuing variation between local authority systems. Depending on where someone lives, there can be differences in which materials are accepted, container types and colours and whether glass is collected at the kerbside.
paragraphs.zh: 苏格兰的回收服务仍然不一致和混乱。这在一定程度上是由于地方当局系统之间的持续变化。根据人们的居住地，在接受哪些材料，容器类型和颜色以及是否在路边收集玻璃方面可能存在差异。

paragraphs.en: The wide variation between councils, from 18.2% to 56.5%, points to inconsistent services rather than individual attitudes alone.
paragraphs.zh: 议会之间的差异很大，从18.2%到56.5%，这表明服务不一致，而不仅仅是个人态度。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Scotland has struggled to introduce a return scheme for drinks containers, where a deposit is paid and then returned when recycled. Initially expected to start in October 2025, this has been postponed to October 2027, and will no longer include glass, due to wrangles with the UK government over devolved powers.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，苏格兰一直在努力推出一项饮料容器回收计划，即支付存款，然后在回收时返还。最初预计将于2025年10月开始，但由于与英国政府就下放权力发生争执，这一计划已推迟至2027年10月，并且将不再包括玻璃。

paragraphs.en: This was expected to raise recycling levels of eligible drinks containers to around 90%. A similar deposit scheme in Ireland has been very successful at pushing up recycling levels.
paragraphs.zh: 预计这将使符合条件的饮料容器的回收率提高到90%左右。爱尔兰的一个类似的存款计划在提高回收率方面非常成功。

paragraphs.en: What Wales gets right
paragraphs.zh: 威尔士做对了什么

paragraphs.en: UK-wide figures also show a distinct difference between the four nations: Wales recycled 58.6% (up from 4.8% of household waste in 1998-99), Northern Ireland 50.1%, England 43.8% and Scotland comes bottom at 42.7% in 2024. These outcomes reflect political choices, not simply how diligently households sort their rubbish. Scotland’s lower rate reflects lack of access to convenient collection systems, cost barriers, limited reprocessing capacity and increasing incineration of recyclables.
paragraphs.zh: 英国范围内的数据也显示了这四个国家之间的明显差异：威尔士回收58.6%（1998-99年占家庭垃圾的4.8%），北方爱尔兰50.1%，英格兰43.8%，苏格兰在2024年垫底，为42.7%。这些结果反映了政治选择，苏格兰的垃圾分类率较低，反映出缺乏便捷的垃圾收集系统、成本壁垒、有限的再处理能力以及越来越多的可回收垃圾焚烧。

paragraphs.en: Overall, recycling has stalled across England, Scotland and Northern Ireland while incineration of waste has expanded.
paragraphs.zh: 总的来说，在英格兰、苏格兰和北方爱尔兰，回收工作已经停滞，而垃圾焚烧则有所扩大。

paragraphs.en: The municipal rate of recycling has increased to 68.4% in 2024-25. Municipal waste includes all local-authority-collected waste, including some commercial waste, street sweepings and litter bins.
paragraphs.zh: 在2024-25年度，市政回收率已增至68.4%。市政废物包括所有地方当局收集的废物，包括一些商业废物、街道清扫物和垃圾箱。

paragraphs.en: But Wales shows that stagnation in recycling levels is not inevitable, and the nation has become a global leader on this front.
paragraphs.zh: 但威尔士表明，回收水平的停滞并非不可避免，该国已成为这方面的全球领导者。

paragraphs.en: This reflects a sustained Welsh government policy, reinforced in 2021 with a new approach that set statutory local authority targets, invested in collections, as well as monitoring and political backing. Wales also imposed a moratorium on new large-scale energy-from-waste developments in 2021.
paragraphs.zh: 这反映了威尔士政府持续的政策，并在2021年通过新方法得到加强，该方法设定了法定地方当局目标，投资于收集，以及监督和政治支持。威尔士还在2021年暂停了新的大规模废物能源开发项目。

paragraphs.en: The Welsh system is not perfect. Its municipal rate remained below the 70% national target for 2024-25. Nevertheless, 20 of its 22 local authorities improved, demonstrating what sustained institutional pressure can achieve. Its experience suggests that targets work best when they are backed by infrastructure, accountability and stable long-term policy.
paragraphs.zh: 威尔士的制度并不完美。它的市政率仍然低于2024- 2025年70%的国家目标。尽管如此，22个地方政府中有20个有所改善，这表明持续的制度压力可以实现什么。它的经验表明，当目标得到基础设施、问责制和稳定的长期政策的支持时，它们的效果最好。

paragraphs.en: Recycling history
paragraphs.zh: 回收历史

paragraphs.en: The first UK recycling in the early 2000s focused on relatively accessible materials such as paper, glass, metals and garden waste.
paragraphs.zh: 21世纪初，英国第一次回收利用集中在相对容易获得的材料上，如纸张、玻璃、金属和花园垃圾。

paragraphs.en: But further progress depends on addressing food waste, plastic films, textiles, electrical products and complex packaging.
paragraphs.zh: 但进一步的进展取决于解决食物垃圾、塑料薄膜、纺织品、电气产品和复杂包装。

paragraphs.en: These streams are harder to collect, separate and process, while markets for some recovered materials, where waste is reused, remain uncertain. Variable quality, volatile prices and weak demand for some materials increase costs and risk, potentially leaving councils without buyers.
paragraphs.zh: 这些物流更难收集、分离和处理，而一些废物再利用的回收材料的市场仍然不确定。一些材料的质量不稳定、价格波动和需求疲软增加了成本和风险，可能会让地方议会找不到买家。

paragraphs.en: Another reason recycling have not climbed as high as predicted is that people cannot recycle materials that councils do not collect. To help people recycle more it is important to eliminate confusing labels, redesign packaging that was never designed to be recycled or create new markets for recovered materials.
paragraphs.zh: 回收率没有达到预期水平的另一个原因是，人们不能回收议会不收集的材料。为了帮助人们更多地回收，重要的是消除令人困惑的标签，重新设计从未设计用于回收的包装，或者为回收材料创造新的市场。

paragraphs.en: Burning not burying
paragraphs.zh: 燃烧而不是掩埋

paragraphs.en: It’s important to note that landfill reduction is also an important environmental achievement, and in Scotland, for instance, landfill use has declined – down 82.5% since 2011 – although incineration has increased. In 2024 1.86 million tonnes was incinerated, an increase of 239,000 tonnes (14.7%) from 2023. Poorly managed landfill sites can pollute soil and water, release methane and require monitoring long after closure. The 1999 EU Landfill Directive, landfill tax, statutory targets and kerbside collections helped transform the system.
paragraphs.zh: 值得注意的是，减少垃圾填埋场也是一项重要的环境成就，例如，在苏格兰，垃圾填埋场的使用量已经下降-自2011年以来下降了82.5%-尽管焚烧量有所增加。2024年，焚烧量为186万吨，增加了239吨，管理不善的垃圾填埋场会污染土壤和水，释放甲烷，并需要在关闭后很长时间内进行监测。1999年欧盟垃圾填埋指令，垃圾填埋税，法定目标和路边收集帮助改变了系统。

paragraphs.en: But the UK is increasingly burning what it no longer wants to bury. In 2024, 63 energy-from-waste plants burned 16.8 million tonnes of residual waste. Since 2024, there are ten incinerators under construction in England and two in Scotland, but none in Wales and Northern Ireland. As people recycle more there’s less need for these, so why are so many being built?
paragraphs.zh: 但英国越来越多地焚烧它不再想掩埋的东西。2024年，63家垃圾发电厂焚烧了1680万吨残余垃圾。自2024年以来，英格兰有10座焚烧厂在建，苏格兰有2座，但威尔士和北方爱尔兰没有。随着人们越来越多地回收利用垃圾，对这些垃圾的需求就越来越少，那么为什么要建这么多？

paragraphs.en: For non-recyclable waste, modern incineration may be preferable to landfill. It reduces waste volume and can generate electricity or heat. But it is controversial. Incineration is the dirtiest way the UK generates power. It emits carbon and causes smells as well as destroying materials that could otherwise remain in use. It also often causes nearby residents to worry about health risks.
paragraphs.zh: 对于不可回收的废物，现代焚烧可能比填埋更可取。它减少了废物的体积，并可以发电或供热。但这是有争议的。焚烧是英国最肮脏的发电方式。它会排放碳，产生气味，并破坏原本可以继续使用的材料。它还经常导致附近居民担心健康风险。

paragraphs.en: In 2024, 82.3% of Scottish household waste classified as “other diversion from landfill” was managed through incineration. Landfilled household waste fell by 37.7%, but the quantity managed through “other diversion” rose by 16.1%. Scotland is therefore managing its residual waste differently, but without achieving an equivalent improvement in waste prevention or recovering or reusing materials.
paragraphs.zh: 2024年，82.3%的苏格兰家庭垃圾被归类为“从填埋场转移”，通过焚烧进行管理。填埋的家庭垃圾减少了37.7%，但通过“其他转移”管理的数量增加了16.1%。因此，苏格兰以不同的方式管理其剩余垃圾，但在垃圾预防或回收或再利用材料方面没有取得同等的改善。

paragraphs.en: The next waste revolution
paragraphs.zh: 下一次废物革命

paragraphs.en: The UK’s reduction in how much waste it deposits into landfill was the first waste revolution. The next change must be preventing waste and keeping products and materials in use for longer.
paragraphs.zh: 英国减少垃圾填埋量是第一次垃圾革命，下一次变革必须是防止浪费，延长产品和材料的使用寿命。

paragraphs.en: Governments should ensure residual waste contracts do not penalise councils for reducing rubbish. They should reward durable, repairable and genuinely recyclable products. Priority should be given to food, flexible plastics, textiles, electrical equipment and complex packaging.
paragraphs.zh: 各国政府应确保剩余废物合同不会惩罚减少垃圾的地方政府。它们应奖励耐用、可修复和真正可回收的产品。应优先考虑食品、软塑料、纺织品、电气设备和复杂包装。

paragraphs.en: Wales shows that sustained recycling progress is also possible. The next waste revolution will begin when conserving materials takes priority over finding another way to destroy them. Those in Scotland who want the country to take an environmental leadership role should take note.
paragraphs.zh: 威尔士表明，可持续的回收利用也是可能的。下一场废物革命将开始，届时，保护材料将优先于寻找另一种销毁材料的方法。那些希望苏格兰发挥环境领导作用的人应该注意到这一点。
